question: Does pinned HF also generate a degenerate continuation from each saved onset?
decision: After a completed HF continuation flags, stop redundant remaining seeds for that case and move to the other case. A coherent first sample does not settle the question; retain additional seeds.
reason: Full TT reproduces both. One completed positive HF reproduction establishes that the same phenomenon exists in reference behavior; no population anomaly-rate equivalence is claimed. CPU reference has no accessible GPU and longprefix conditioning is costly.
limits: Preserve all completed samples, partial planned-batch status and exact exit reason. Never terminate TT work. Only own CPU reference process may be stopped after completed saved evidence. Subsequent case keeps same1024cap, seed42, T1/p.95/k20 and same savedIDs.
cost: One model reload and second prefix prefill versus two extra1024-token CPU trials after a positive reproduction.

qualitative_clarification.criterion: A completed HF sample either flags mechanically or is independently inspected and confirmed to contain repeated-token/phrase cycles without actions. Unflagged does not mean coherent. Preserve detector values and human classification separately.
qualitative_clarification.basis: All six unflagged TT controls visibly repeat multi-phrase cycles; zlib threshold misses these longer cycles. Supplemental task triage requested before HF result exists.
